McAllen museum celebrates lowrider culture with market and community event

6 hours 53 minutes 12 seconds ago Monday, September 14 2026 Sep 14, 2026 September 14, 2026 6:15 PM September 14, 2026 in News - Local
Source: KRGV
By: Joel Villanueva
Share:
This video file cannot be played.(Error Code: 102630)
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

The International Museum of Art and Science will be hosting a "Day of Play — Lowrider Community Day and Market."

IMAS Curator Marcelo Ramirez Garcia-Rojas spoke with Channel 5 News' Joel Villanueva about the event.

Scheduled for Sept. 26 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., the event ties into a Smithsonian exhibition titled "Lowrider Culture in the United States."

For tickets to the event, click here.
